descriptions.zh: 随着不断与新物种遭遇，我们对各种独特的['concept_evopred_genetic_insights']进行分析、传播。一旦完成，我们就可以演化，向我们的基因编码中永久性地增添新的正面§Y物种特质§!。
descriptions.en: Unique ['concept_evopred_genetic_insights'] are analyzed and disseminated as we encounter new species. Once finished, we will evolve, permanently adding a new positive §YSpecies Trait§! to our own genetic code.

descriptions.zh:
我们需要一些时间来适应如此庞大的形态。在融入这个身体的过程中，我们必须时刻保持对周围环境的警觉。如今，我们与虚空之间已无任何阻隔。

descriptions.en:
It will take some time for us to adjust to a form so massive in scale. As we grow into this body, we must remain aware of our surroundings. There now stands nothing between us and the void.

Our current ['concept_growth_factor'] is: §G[growth_factor_value]%§!
